image_description: A black assault rifle (appearing to be an AR-15/M4 platform variant) lying on a white surface next to a video game case titled 'Unreal Tournament 2003'. The rifle features a carry handle, pistol grip, stock, and handguard. A black lanyard is attached to the front sling swivel.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Compact automatic firearm with characteristic profile of barrel receiver and stock aligned linearly.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows a firearm with the classic linear alignment of stock, receiver, and barrel typical of the AR-15/M4 family.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Overall length is substantial with barrel comprising a significant portion of total length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The barrel is visibly long relative to the receiver and stock, consistent with a carbine or rifle-length gas system.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Matte black or dark gray finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The firearm exhibits a uniform matte black finish on both metal and polymer components.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metallic receiver housing firing mechanism with detachable box magazine inserted below.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The upper and lower receivers are distinct, and a standard curved magazine is inserted into the mag well.
The barrel extends forward from the handguard and terminates in a visible birdcage-style flash hider.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pistol grip collapsible or fixed stock and handguard surrounding barrel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A pistol grip is visible below the trigger guard, a telescoping stock is at the rear, and a ribbed handguard surrounds the barrel.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Parkerized or anodized metal with polymer furniture.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While likely true for this class of object, specific material composition (parkerizing vs anodizing) cannot be definitively verified via visual inspection alone without macro detail or metadata.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Upper receiver has carrying handle or Picatinny rail for optics.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The upper receiver features a prominent integrated carrying handle with rear sight aperture, characteristic of M4/M16 variants.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Distinguishing features include magazine well and ejection port.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The magazine well is clearly defined where the magazine inserts, and the ejection port cover area is visible on the right side of the receiver.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model variant (e.g., M4 vs M16) and ensure it aligns with the 'assault rifle' class label rather than a hunting rifle or submachine gun.
To check for edge bleeding between the complex mechanical parts (handguard, receiver) and the background, ensuring structural continuity.
To verify if the text on the adjacent game case ('Unreal Tournament') is rendered correctly or shows AI gibberish artifacts.
To ensure the rifle sits flat on the surface with correct shadowing and depth separation from the game case.

focus_areas: Mechanical consistency of the receiver and trigger group
Alignment of the barrel and handguard
Legibility of text on the game case
Edge sharpness around the carry handle and stock
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection points of the rifle components (stock-to-receiver, barrel-to-receiver). AI often fails at these mechanical junctions. Also, scrutinize the text on the game case; even if the rifle is perfect, garbled text indicates an AI generation artifact. Verify if the 'M4' style handguard ribs are symmetrical and physically plausible.
